subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared cross-channel inbound attachment metadata contract, or keep Slack on placeholders, media paths, and `download-file` only?
rationale: The useful fix changes the agent-facing channel/plugin contract, and current repository policy treats that as a shared boundary decision rather than a Slack-only implementation detail.

options.title: Add shared attachment metadata
options.body: Introduce a narrow `InboundAttachments`-style context shape and populate it from Slack first while keeping current media fields compatible.

options.title: Add Slack-only metadata
options.body: Expose only Slack file ids or richer Slack placeholder text faster, accepting channel drift and a likely later migration.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Rely on placeholders, `MediaPath`/`MediaPaths`, docs, and `download-file` without adding a new metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Add shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow `InboundAttachments`-style context shape and populate it from Slack first while keeping current media fields compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history points to steipete as the strongest current owner for the shared Slack/channel context boundary.
